data.name: Abwah
data.gender_notes: Abwah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abw' which means 'to serve'. The name Abwah is used to denote a servant of God. The name Abwah carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abwah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who believe in God's promises and trust in His plan.
data.etymology: Abwah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abwah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أبوة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الأبوة، يعني القوة والشجاعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أبوة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'أ ب و' الذي يعني القوة والشجاعة. يرمز الاسم إلى الصفات الحميدة مثل الحنان والرعاية، وغالبًا ما يرتبط بالشخصيات القوية والمتحمسة. في القرآن الكريم، لا يوجد ذكر صريح للاسم، لكن الجذر اللغوي له يظهر في عدة آيات، مما يعطي الاسم عمقًا دينيًا وثقافيًا.

in_urdu.name: ابوہ
in_urdu.meaning: ابوہ نام کا مطلب ہے مضبوطی، شجاعت، اور محبت
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابوہ نام عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'أ ب و' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوطی، شجاعت، اور محبت۔ یہ نام ان صفات کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد کو مضبوط اور قابل اعتماد بناتی ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام احترام اور فخر کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر اس کے تعلق سے جو ابوہ بنت زايد کے ساتھ منسوب ہے، جو اسلام کی اولیه تاریخ میں ایک اہم شخصیت تھیں۔

in_hindi.name: अबूअ
in_hindi.meaning: अबूअ नाम का अर्थ है शक्ति, साहस और प्रेम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अबूअ नाम अरबी भाषा की जड़ 'أ ب و' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति, साहस और प्रेम। यह नाम उन गुणों का प्रतीक है जो एक व्यक्ति को मजबूत और विश्वसनीय बनाते हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम सम्मान और गर्व के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है, खासकर इसके जुड़ाव के कारण जो अबूअ बिन्त ज़ैद के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है, जो इस्लाम के प्रारंभिक इतिहास में एक महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्ति थीं।

in_pashto.name: ابوہ
in_pashto.meaning: ابوہ د قوي او مهرباني معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ابوہ نوم د عربي ژبې د ريښې 'أ ب و' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د قوي، مهرباني او پاملرنې معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د هغو ځانګړتيو استازیتوب کوي چې يو فرد قوي او باوري کوي. د افغان او پښتون دوديزو کې، دا نوم د احترام او فخر سره کارول کيږي، په ځانګړي ډول د هغې اړيکې له امله چې د ابوہ بنت زايد سره نسبت لري، چا چې د اسلام په لومړيو تاريخ کې يو مهم شخصيت وه.

in_english.name: Abwah
in_english.meaning: Abwah means strength, courage, and love in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abwah is derived from the Arabic root 'أ ب و', signifying strength, courage, and paternal love. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root appears in several verses, lending the name a rich religious and cultural context. Historically, Abwah has been associated with Abwah bint Zayd, an important figure in early Islamic history. The name symbolizes positive attributes such as kindness, protection, and resilience, making it a meaningful choice for a child.

pronunciation.urdu: ابوہ کا تلفظ 'ا ب و ہ' ہے
pronunciation.pashto: د ابوہ تلفظ د 'ابوہ' په شان دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Abwah holds a rich cultural significance in Arabic and Islamic societies. The word 'abwah' in its truest sense signifies a humble servant. In a community setting, an individual bearing this name would be seen as a dedicated servant, a respectable figure who is selfless and always ready to serve others. This cultural meaning profoundly resonates with one of the central themes of the Islamic faith, which is serving God and His creation. Therefore, the name Abwah is a constant reminder of the importance of service and selflessness in maintaining a harmonious society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Abwah is a powerful declaration of one's intention to serve and worship God alone. In Islamic tradition, serving God is an act of devotion, a way to connect with the divine, and a fulfillment of God's will. The name Abwah signifies a deep connection to this spiritual path, and a commitment to fulfilling the duty of serving God, as mentioned in the Quran: "And I did not create the jinn and humankind except to worship Me." (Ad-Dhariyat 51:56). By bearing this name, an individual is consistently reminded of their role as a servant of God, and is encouraged to live a life that reflects this spiritual commitment.
